sub_answers.text: The earliest para-swimming classification system was created in the 1940s and was based on medical conditions [d36583541s3p0]. During the late 1960s and early 1970s classification was set up as a series of "handicaps" that increased the number of classes substantially [d36583541s3p0]. Medical classifiers examined athletes in a supine position on an examination table during the 1960s and 1970s, with multiple medical classifiers assessing muscles and using pins in the examinations [d36583541s3p0]. Governance of swimming classification and approval of classifications was the responsibility of FINA until 1992, when the International Paralympic Committee took over classification governance [d36583541s0p0].
